title: Successive list drops
statement: Let $E$ and $r$ be finite bit strings, let $p$ be a natural number, and let $b$ be a bit. If removing the first $p$ bits of $E$ gives the string beginning with $b$ and followed by $r$, then removing the first $p+1$ bits of $E$ gives $r$.
hypotheses_covered: $E$ with its first $p$ entries removed equals $b$ followed by $r$
